subject: One-off resilience credit for April latency spike - NimblePay
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@nimblepay.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: NimblePay Legal <legal@nimblepay.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: April latency spike — request for remediation/credit

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking my call earlier. As we discussed, NimblePay saw sustained tail-latency on several inference routes between 2026-04-14 02:00 UTC and 2026-04-14 07:30 UTC that materially impacted our payment-notification pipeline (increased timeouts, retry storms). Our Ops and SRE teams captured traces and a short incident timeline — attaching the uptime/latency export for your reference.

We appreciate Redwood's transparent updates during the event, but this incident caused measurable customer-facing delays and extra engineering toil on our side. Given the business impact, we are requesting: 1) a one-off credit that offsets April service charges tied to the affected routes, and 2) a short-term SLA amendment that adds an explicit remediation milestone while you complete the post-mortem.

Can you share the proposed remediation/credit path and the internal approvals cadence? NimblePay needs a clear timeline to brief our leadership and Legal.

Regards,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
NimblePay

Attachments: nimblepay-uptime-apr-2026.pdf (pdf)
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: April latency spike — request for remediation/credit

Sanjay — thanks for the detail and for sending the traces. I’ve looped in Jonas (CS) to ensure NimblePay has a clean MRP and customer-facing summary while I coordinate the credit approval internally.

Next steps from my side: I’ll send a request to Sales Ops and our Revenue leadership for a one-off concession. Typical approach is a revenue offset tied to the impacted days + a short free-month credit for the impacted routes. I will propose a conservative package and ask for expedited approval given the customer impact.

I’ll follow up with an internal decision timeline by end of day Monday.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Director, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: [Approval request] NimblePay — one-off credit & short SLA amendment (NP-7834)

Team — NimblePay (NP-7834) asked for a remediation/credit after an April 14 tail-latency event that degraded their payment-notification flow. Quick summary:
- Impact window: 2026-04-14 02:00 — 07:30 UTC (traces attached).
- Measured error: increased p99 latency and retry amplification, confirmed by customer traces and our logs.
- Customer ask: one-off credit to offset April charges for the affected routes + a short-term SLA amendment stating a remediation milestone.

Proposed customer-facing package (recommendation):
1) Revenue offset equal to 30% of the billable tokens for the affected routes in April (conservative by estimate).
2) One free month of service for the same routes (applied as a credit on next invoice).
3) Provide a dedicated post-mortem within 5 business days and a technical remediation milestone within 30 days.

Rationale: visible remediation + combined monetary and service concession helps preserve the renewal momentum (deal at 9-figure ARR run rate for NimblePay). NimblePay has been a high-usage, low-churn customer; we are favoring an expedited approval to avoid executive escalation.

Attachments: nimblepay-uptime-apr-2026.pdf; proposed-credit-authorization.docx

Please reply with APPROVE / REJECT and any adjustments. If APPROVE, share any legal billing caveats that need to be added to the document.

Thanks,
Neha
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Approval request] NimblePay — one-off credit & short SLA amendment (NP-7834)

APPROVE with conditions.

I support the proposed package (30% offset + one free month + PM timeline). Conditions:
- Finance must sign the credit memo; Marissa, please generate the formal credit memo and confirm gross-to-net P&L impact.
- Legal needs to add a limited-scope amendment that explicitly states this is a one-off, non-precedent-setting concession; NimblePay Legal will need that language before we issue the credit.
- We should attach a short note that ties the credit to the root-cause fix timeline (30 days) and include a pass/fail metric for remediation completion. If remediation misses the milestone, propose a scoped follow-up credit (to be reviewed).

Marissa — please coordinate the credit memo and, once ready, I’ll sign off so Neha can communicate to the customer. Jonas — please prepare the post-mortem summary for the customer-facing write-up.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, NimblePay Legal <legal@nimblepay.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: April latency spike — request for remediation/credit

Sanjay — quick update and next steps. Thank you for sending the traces and for the patience while we worked the internal approval path. Per our internal approvals, Redwood will: 

1) Issue a one-off revenue offset equal to 30% of April billable tokens for the affected inference routes; the credit will appear on your next invoice as a line-item credit (Finance is generating the credit memo).
2) Apply one month of service credit for the same routes (applied as a separate invoice credit).
3) Provide a customer-facing post-mortem within 3 business days and a technical remediation milestone (targeted completion within 30 days). If the remediation milestone is not met, we will re-evaluate additional remedial options.

Next actions: Marissa will follow up with the formal credit memo and payment impact; Jonas will send the post-mortem draft by end of day Wednesday. Legal — I’ve CC’d your counsel; please let us know if you need a short amendment with the one-off language Karthik mentioned.

Thanks again,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Director, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
